name: Piuro (Italy)
description: White field charged at the centre with the black oval seal of Piuro: a double-headed eagle within a ring bearing the inscription PLVRII COMVNITAS in red.
history: Municipal flag of Piuro, a comune in Lombardy; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office. The arms and gonfalone were granted by decree of the President of the Republic on 9 June 1965.

features.role: oval seal with a double-headed eagle
inscription PLVRII COMVNITAS around the seal
